name: Preflight Handoff Audits
author: levmedia

sections.description:
Preflight Handoff Audits helps WordPress builders and agencies review a site before launch or client handoff.

Run a read-only scan, identify high-risk pages, work through Build Mode, open Fix Coach for page-specific guidance, complete the manual checklist, and generate internal or client-facing handoff reports.

What Preflight helps you do

  • Audit published pages, posts, and WooCommerce products before launch or delivery.
  • Find content, layout, form, link, access, mobile, WooCommerce, and deployment readiness issues.
  • Prioritize the highest-risk pages using the Overview and Build Mode.
  • Open supported editors with page-specific guidance through Fix Coach.
  • Complete a structured manual handoff checklist.
  • Generate internal and client-facing handoff reports.

Built for the working phase

Preflight is designed for use throughout a WordPress build, not only during the final hour before launch. Compare scans, track resolved issues, identify repeated patterns, and focus on what should be fixed next.

Read-only and local

Preflight does not automatically rewrite content or change site settings. Scan results and checklist progress are stored locally in WordPress and are not sent to an external scanning service.

Supported workflows

Preflight includes targeted checks for WordPress content, WooCommerce, common launch settings, client access risks, Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, and Divi Contact Form modules.

Core promise

Find layout, content, and handoff issues before your client does.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the preflight-handoff-audits folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Preflight Handoff Audits from the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Preflight in the WordPress admin.
  4. Click Run Preflight Scan.
sections.faq:
Does Preflight change my website?

No. Preflight scans are read-only. The plugin does not automatically rewrite content, change settings, create orders, submit forms, or modify WooCommerce products.

Does scan data leave my website?

No. Scan results, scan history, and checklist state are stored locally in WordPress. Preflight does not send scan data to an external scanning service.

Which content types are scanned?

Preflight scans published pages and posts. WooCommerce products are also included when WooCommerce is active.

What does Preflight check?

Preflight reviews common handoff risks involving content, headings, placeholder links, forms, images, mobile layouts, WooCommerce settings, client access, security readiness, performance and SEO readiness, and deployment preparation.

The checks are intended to guide a manual review. They do not certify that a site is accessible, secure, optimized, or launch-ready.

Which page builders and form plugins are supported?

Preflight includes targeted checks and Fix Coach workflows for common WordPress editors, Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, and Divi Contact Form modules.

Support depends on the information each plugin or builder exposes in stored or rendered content.

Can I create a client report?

Yes. Preflight includes an Internal view and a cleaner Client view. Reports can be copied, printed, or saved as PDF using the browser print dialog.

Does Preflight replace SEO, security, accessibility, or performance tools?

No. Preflight identifies common handoff and launch-readiness risks. It complements specialist SEO, security, accessibility, performance, and vulnerability tools rather than replacing them.

What is Build Mode?

Build Mode is the daily working view after a scan. It highlights what to fix next, which pages need attention, what changed since the previous scan, and repeated patterns that may be worth fixing together.

What is Fix Coach?

Fix Coach is a small helper panel that opens on supported editor or builder URLs from a Fix action. It shows the page-specific issue list, can try to highlight matching elements, and includes a Back to Preflight link.

Does the handoff checklist change the scan score?

No. The manual checklist progress is shown separately from the Preflight score.
